global_editorial_findings: Many entries follow a uniform three-sentence image→moral→disclaimer pattern. This undercuts requested lived-cultural narrative. Vary endings and let observation or conversational effect carry the meaning.

Do not remove meaningful prejudice/violence/kinship/agency cautions from012/015/036/038/039/041/044/045/047/058/062/064/066/067/068/070/071/080. Uncertain readings031/047/053/060 must remain qualified.

Routine weather/medical/zoological/legal/origin caveats can remain in existing cultural_context/notes rather than being repeated as every main Odia ending. Avoid replacing them with newly invented childhood scenes or origin tales.

checks: Opening changed to without special effort, not before trying.
Lemon relationship sentence now asks where to stop.
Child-learning question asks what image comes to mind.

limits: No original source retrieval repeated; review against existing approved English explanation/context/headwords.
Separate AI review only, not human/native-speaker certification.
Approval is only001–080 exact proposed-text hashes; no081–159 approval claimed.
Final rendered layout and integrated preservation remain separate checks.

revision_recheck.assessment: Meaning corrections resolved; routine caveat endings replaced with relevant conversational interpretation. Harm/identity/uncertain lexical cautions preserved. Uniform shortparagraph style remains an editorial characteristic, not a meaning blocker.
revision_recheck.optional_polish: 033 second/thirdsentences repeat welcome/hurt contrast; can tighten later without changing meaning, but no further correction required for acceptance.
